items.title_en: 'Frankenstein' rabbits with 'tentacles' spotted across US again
items.title_zh: 美国各地再次发现长有“触手”的“弗兰肯斯坦”兔子
items.summary_en: Ever looked at a fluffy bunny and nearly vomited due to its grotesque appearance? Today might be that day as locals report seeing freaky ‘Frankenstein’ rabbits once again. Americans across areas like Wisconsin , Minnesota and New York have increasingly been encountering the strange creatures, which sees bunnies sporting black tentacles on their faces and heads. This comes almost one year after Fort Collins, Colorado, was rocked by an influx of the rabbits, leading to Colorado Parks and Wildlife to issue a warning…
items.summary_zh: 你有没有见过一只毛茸茸的兔子，因为它奇特的外表而差点吐出来？今天可能就是这一天，当地人报告说他们再次看到了怪异的“弗兰肯斯坦”兔子。威斯康星州、明尼苏达州和纽约等地区的美国人越来越多地遇到这种奇怪的生物，这些兔子的脸上和头上都长着黑色的触手。大约一年前，科罗拉多州柯林斯堡因兔子涌入而震惊，导致科罗拉多州
